name: Breakdown
summary: This EA implements a breakdown/breakout strategy that enters trades when price breaks through predefined support or resistance levels. It identifies key price levels and opens positions in the direction of the breakout, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves after price escapes a consolidation range.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了突破策略，当价格突破预设的支撑或阻力位时入场交易。它识别关键价格水平并在突破方向开仓，旨在捕捉价格脱离盘整区间后的动量行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是突破交易，通过识别关键支撑和阻力水平，在价格突破这些水平时顺势入场。入场条件为价格收盘突破前期高点或低点，确认突破有效性后开仓做多或做空。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及可选的追踪止损，锁定利润同时控制风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态计算方式，允许用户调整风险敞口。资金管理方面提供风险比例设置，但缺乏对最大持仓和连续亏损的系统性控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破确认机制较为简单，可能出现假突破导致的频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is breakout trading, entering positions when price breaks through identified support and resistance levels. Entry conditions trigger when price closes above a prior swing high for longs or below a swing low for shorts, confirming the breakout before opening a position. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with an optional trailing stop to lock in profits while controlling downside risk. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on account equity, allowing users to adjust their risk exposure. Money management provides risk percentage settings but lacks systematic controls for maximum concurrent positions and consecutive loss limits. The overall strategy logic is clear, but the breakout confirmation mechanism is relatively simple, which may lead to frequent stop-outs from false breakouts.

parameters.name: TrailingStop

parameters.description_en: Breakout identification period for high/low calculation

parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险比例（百分比）

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和参数调优
结合了突破入场和追踪止损，能有效捕捉趋势行情
提供固定手数和风险比例两种仓位管理模式，灵活性较好
止损设置明确，单笔风险可控
支持多品种多周期运行，适用范围广
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and easy to understand, facilitating parameter tuning
Combines breakout entry with trailing stop, effectively capturing trending moves
Provides both fixed lot and risk-percentage position sizing modes for flexibility
Clear stop-loss settings keep per-trade risk manageable
Supports multi-symbol and multi-timeframe operation with broad applicability
cons: 突破确认机制简单，缺乏成交量或动量过滤，容易遭遇假突破
没有防重复开仓检查，可能在同一突破信号上多次入场
缺乏最大持仓限制和连续亏损保护，极端行情下风险集中
追踪止损参数固定，不适应市场波动率变化
缺少点差过滤，在低流动性时段突破信号质量差
cons_en: Breakout confirmation is simplistic, lacking volume or momentum filters, making it vulnerable to false breakouts
No duplicate trade check, potentially opening multiple positions on the same breakout signal
Lacks maximum position limits and consecutive loss protection, concentrating risk in extreme markets
Trailing stop parameter is fixed and does not adapt to changing market volatility
Missing spread filter, resulting in poor signal quality during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加成交量或ATR过滤条件，提高突破信号可靠性
添加新K线检查和最大持仓限制，避免重复开仓和过度风险暴露
引入动态追踪止损，根据ATR调整止损距离以适应市场波动率变化
improvements_en: Add volume or ATR filters to improve breakout signal reliability
Implement new bar check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and excessive risk exposure
Introduce dynamic trailing stop based on ATR to adapt stop distance to market volatility changes

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线内重复开仓
无最大持仓限制，极端突破行情下可能过度加仓
固定追踪止损在高波动市场可能过早被止损出局
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries within the same candle
No maximum position limit could lead to over-loading in extreme breakout scenarios
Fixed trailing stop may be stopped out prematurely in high-volatility markets

It identifies key price levels and opens positions in the direction of the breakout, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves after price escapes a consolidation range.
